Interface FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder

All Superinterfaces:
FastStatsContext.Builder
All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder
Enclosing interface:
FastStatsContext
public static sealed interface FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder extends FastStatsContext.Builder permits SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder
Builder for FastStatsContext on platforms that can ask the user for consent, such as game clients.

By default, no consent is required.

Since:
0.33.0

  • Method Details

    • requireConsent

      @Contract(value=" -> this", mutates="this") FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder requireConsent()
      Requires the user to explicitly give consent before anything is submitted.

      When at least one project requires consent, the consent screen is shown until it was shown once, nothing is submitted before that. Platforms without a consent screen, such as dedicated servers, ignore this setting.

      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • token

      FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder token(@Nullable String token)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Sets the FastStats project token.

      If no token is set, the token injected at build time is read, if a token resource was configured. Without any token, the created context is disabled.

      Specified by:
      token in interface FastStatsContext.Builder
      Parameters:
      token - the FastStats project token, or null
      Returns:
      this builder

    • onReady

      FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder onReady(Consumer<FastStatsContext> hook)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Adds a hook that runs once when the context becomes ready.

      If a hook fails, the context stays not ready and all hooks run again on the next call, so hooks must be safe to run more than once.

      Specified by:
      onReady in interface FastStatsContext.Builder
      Parameters:
      hook - the hook
      Returns:
      this builder

    • service

      FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder service(Function<SimpleContext, ? extends FastStatsService> service)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Adds an optional service to the context.

      The factory receives the created context, so the service can use its logger, configuration, scheduler and submission helpers. Services are started before the metrics submission task and shut down before the metrics are flushed.

      Specified by:
      service in interface FastStatsContext.Builder
      Parameters:
      service - the service factory
      Returns:
      this builder
